recorded_lightning_contribution_count.definition: Distinct confirmed Geyser contributions having at least one PAID payment whose type indicates that the contributor initiated payment over Lightning.
recorded_lightning_contribution_count.zap_like_use: This is the recommended Geyser count for cross-platform charts of zap-like funding actions.
recorded_lightning_contribution_count.caveat: One contribution is one application-level funding action. Direct-to-creator payments that do not create a Geyser contribution are absent.

recorded_lightning_payment_count.definition: Distinct PAID Geyser payment records in payer-origin Lightning categories: LIGHTNING, LIGHTNING_PODCAST_KEYSEND, and LIGHTNING_TO_RSK_SWAP.
recorded_lightning_payment_count.safe_language: paid Lightning payment records attached to recorded Geyser contributions
recorded_lightning_payment_count.caveat: A contribution can theoretically contain more than one paid payment record, so this can differ from the contribution count.

recorded_lightning_contribution_sats.definition: Sum of the contribution amount credited by Geyser, counted once per recorded Lightning-funded contribution.
recorded_lightning_contribution_sats.safe_language: sats credited to recorded Lightning-funded contributions
recorded_lightning_contribution_sats.caveat: This can be lower than the amount paid because payment or platform fees may be excluded.

recorded_lightning_payment_sats.definition: Sum of paymentAmount for included PAID Geyser payment records whose paymentCurrency is BTCSAT.
recorded_lightning_payment_sats.safe_language: sats paid in the included Geyser payment records
recorded_lightning_payment_sats.caveat: This may include fees and should not be described as the amount received by creators.

recorded_lightning_accounting_amount_pai.definition: Sum of Geyser's accountingAmountPaid field for the included PAID payment records.
recorded_lightning_accounting_amount_pai.safe_language: Geyser accounting amount paid for included records
recorded_lightning_accounting_amount_pai.caveat: This is retained as an API cross-check. Use recorded_lightning_payment_sats for the contributor-facing payment amount and recorded_lightning_contribution_sats for credited funding.

median_recorded_contribution_sats.definition: Exact median of Geyser's credited contribution amount across distinct recorded Lightning-funded contributions.
median_recorded_contribution_sats.caveat: This describes Geyser-recorded contributions only, not direct-to-creator payments.

unique_projects_funded.definition: Distinct Geyser project IDs receiving at least one recorded Lightning-funded contribution in the period.
unique_projects_funded.caveat: This does not include projects funded only through unrecorded direct payments.

included_payment_types.LIGHTNING: Contributor paid a Geyser-recorded payment over Lightning.
included_payment_types.LIGHTNING_PODCAST_KEYSEND: Contributor initiated a podcast keysend Lightning payment.
included_payment_types.LIGHTNING_TO_RSK_SWAP: Contributor initiated payment over Lightning and Geyser used a swap for the destination leg.

excluded_payment_type_principle: Do not count a payment as contributor-origin Lightning merely because Lightning appears on the payout or internal side of a fiat, on-chain, or Rootstock swap.
global_caveats: These figures cover only contributions recorded by Geyser's public GraphQL contribution data.
Geyser's temporary direct-payment flow sends users to creator-controlled Bitcoin or Lightning addresses and explicitly does not create Geyser contribution records; those payments are not included.
Do not describe these figures as all Lightning payments associated with Geyser.
Geyser contributions are zap-like funding actions, not NIP-57 Nostr zaps.
The public GraphQL endpoint appears to be an application endpoint rather than a documented, versioned public analytics API and may change without notice.
UTC calendar days differ from the America/Chicago calendar days used by the Stacker News collector.
Treat the observations as public application data, not independently audited Lightning settlement records.
